deterministic_checks.label: diorama mount approximately fills combat shell
old HTML enemy sprite is hidden if detectable

manual_review_items.label: Does combat read as a full-screen 3D battlefield?
manual_review_items.prompt: Inspect combat-hospital.png for full-viewport world ownership rather than a framed inner stage.

manual_review_items.label: Does the 3D world avoid box-inside-box framing?
manual_review_items.prompt: Look for black margins, visible old panel frames, or a diorama that appears trapped inside another container.

manual_review_items.label: Are defenders grounded or still pasted on?
manual_review_items.prompt: Check whether HTML defenders align with stage pads/floor perspective.

manual_review_items.label: Is the enemy anchored to the breach?
manual_review_items.prompt: Confirm the visible enemy-side 3D breach/core owns the threat body presence without duplicate enemy sprites.

manual_review_items.label: Does command UI block the battlefield center?
manual_review_items.prompt: Check whether tactical controls obscure the main action silhouette or preserve readable combat space.

manual_review_items.label: Does party HUD sit bottom-right?
manual_review_items.prompt: Use the screenshot and DOM rects to verify the reserve strip feels anchored to the combat viewport.

manual_review_items.label: Are there duplicate enemy/defender representations?
manual_review_items.prompt: Look for repeated combatants caused by HTML sprites plus 3D placeholders competing for ownership.

what_still_looks_fake: Automated tooling cannot judge whether the battlefield feels cinematic or grounded without human review.
Defender grounding and enemy anchoring still require screenshot inspection against the combat presentation spec.
This critic detects layout/runtime failures, not subjective art quality.
what_should_not_be_touched_next: Combat math, targeting, turn order, modules, rewards, Forge, globe, AudioManager, and save data.
Additional decorative CSS overlays that do not solve a specific composition problem.
Multiple combat canvases or independent render loops.
